lines.text: Start with the parent Company record. In the Fields panel on the left, expand Business to find subsidiary lifetime value.
The four Subsidiary LTV fields are together here, in this order: Revenue, Margin, Won Deals, and Last Rollup.
Revenue and Margin are currency totals. Won Deals is a count. Last Rollup shows the date and time the figures were last refreshed.
This placement is shared across Company records. You do not need to save a separate layout for each company. Check Last Rollup before using the figures in an account review.
